external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Thanks to the new agreement with Bauadvisor, visitors to Palazzo Pallavicini can take advantage of a dedicated dog sitting service. The service can be booked at least 24 hours in advance through the website www.bauadvisor.it, thus offering all dog owners the opportunity to enjoy their visit in total peace.

network.coverage_note: Palazzo Pallavicini is a historic venue and exhibition space, not an educational institution, therefore it does not have Erasmus+ partnerships or mobility programs. The evidence provided focuses on exhibition management and visitor information.
